entries.evidence: Season ended (not closed for good): a VendorsMap listing credited to "Ward 8 Farmers Market Organizers" gives the 2026 season as "Jun 6 - Sep 26, 2026" at the St. Elizabeths Red Lot, matching the market site (June-September) and Not Bored in DC (updated 2026-04-15).
